name: Axiom SkyLux
description: The flying car. Four seats, enclosed cabin, climate control, autopilot. Everything science fiction promised and only the top 2% can afford. The SkyLux is the standard personal air vehicle of the corporate elite — the car that Tier 1 residents see drifting overhead like chrome clouds, untouchable and silent. Seeing one up close is rare. Being inside one is rarer. Owning one means you have already won the game everyone else is still playing.
propulsion: Quad anti-grav pods, electric turbofan propulsion
autonomy: Fully autonomous, Axiom AI flight management, manual override available
armament: None standard. Executive protection package includes countermeasures.
common_usage: Corporate executive transport, luxury personal vehicle, status signal visible from orbit.
story_hooks: A SkyLux crashes in a Tier 1 district and the contents of the trunk reveal something the owner was moving that no one was supposed to see
The Axiom AI flight management system has been refusing to fly certain routes over the city — the restricted zones are expanding
